caption: A stylized animal head with brown, shaggy hair and a white muzzle, wearing a dark grey, ribbed knit beanie with small black ear-like protrusions and a small square patch featuring two white silhouettes. The background is a flat, matte beige. The composition is a tight close-up, centered on the face, with soft, even lighting that highlights the textured fur and the beanie’s fabric. The art style is anime illustration with clean, defined line work and a soft, painterly finish. No visible text.
